editing_pacing: A slideshow of two static images. The first image is shown for the first three seconds, followed by a hard cut to the second image for the remainder of the video.
manipulation_or_satire: The video presents fabricated screenshots of a text message conversation attributed to Donald Trump. This is a form of political satire designed to mock him by putting strange and aggressive statements in his mouth within a fake iMessage chat.
central_claim: The video uses a fabricated text message exchange to portray Donald Trump as incoherent, erratic, and mentally unfit.
intended_effect: To cause the audience to mock Donald Trump and view him as unstable and ridiculous.
